Package com.eqixiac.equinix.core.exception

package com.eqixiac.equinix.core.exception
Exception hierarchy for Equinix API errors. The base EquinixServiceException represents server-side failures, while EquinixClientException covers client-side issues. HTTP status codes are mapped to typed exceptions: 401 to EquinixAuthenticationException, 403 to EquinixAuthorizationException, 404 to EquinixNotFoundException, 409 to EquinixConflictException, 429 to EquinixRateLimitException, and 5xx to EquinixServerException.

    Description
    BaseException
    Root exception class for all Equinix SDK exceptions.
    CircuitOpenException
    Thrown when the opt-in CircuitBreaker is open and a request was rejected without being sent to the API.
    EquinixAuthenticationException
    Thrown when the Equinix API returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
    EquinixAuthorizationException
    Thrown when the Equinix API returns HTTP 403 Forbidden.
    EquinixClientException
    Thrown for client-side errors such as request building failures, serialization errors, or network connectivity issues.
    EquinixConflictException
    Thrown when the Equinix API returns HTTP 409 Conflict.
    EquinixNotFoundException
    Thrown when the Equinix API returns HTTP 404 Not Found.
    EquinixRateLimitException
    Thrown when the Equinix API returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
    EquinixServerException
    Thrown when the Equinix API returns an HTTP 5xx server error (500, 502, 503, 504).
    EquinixServiceException
    Thrown when the Equinix API returns an error HTTP response.
    ExceptionAdditionalInfo
    A property-level error annotation nested inside an ExceptionDetail.
    ExceptionDetail
    One structured error entry parsed from an Equinix API error response body.
